title: Alipay 付款前端 — 結帳金流 + 結果頁面
content:
在前端結帳流程中加入 Alipay 付款選項與跳轉金流。

任務：
1. 結帳頁面 Alipay 付款選項
   - 在付款方式選擇中加入「Alipay 支付寶」選項
   - 選擇 Alipay 後顯示「使用支付寶付款」按鈕
   - 點擊後呼叫 POST /api/payment/alipay/create
   - 取得跳轉 URL 後 redirect 使用者到 Alipay 頁面

2. 付款結果頁 (/[locale]/payment/result)
   - Alipay callback URL 設定到此頁面
   - 顯示付款成功/失敗狀態
   - 成功：顯示綠色的成功訊息、訂單明細、返回按鈕
   - 失敗：顯示紅色的失敗訊息、重試按鈕
   - Loading state（等待 callback 驗證）

3. 付款等待頁 (/[locale]/payment/pending)
   - 顯示「正在跳轉至支付寶...」訊息
   - 自動 redirect 到 Alipay
   - 手動點擊連結備用

4. i18n 支援
   - dict 提供所有付款頁面文字
   - 三語（en, zh-hk, zh-cn）

⚠️ 依賴 AF-013 的 API routes。
⚠️ 金流頁面需處理瀏覽器重新整理、返回按鈕等邊緣情況。
acceptance: Checkout page has Alipay as selectable payment method
Selecting Alipay shows 'Pay with Alipay' button
Clicking button calls API and redirects to Alipay
Payment result page (/payment/result) shows success/failure with correct styling
Success page shows order summary and 'Return to Dashboard' button
Failure page shows retry button that re-initiates payment
Payment pending page shows loading state with manual link fallback
Browser refresh and back button handled (no duplicate payments)
All labels use dict (i18n: en, zh-hk, zh-cn)
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/payment/result/page.tsx (new — payment result page with success/failure states)
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && visit checkout → select Alipay → redirected to Alipay sandbox → callback → result page shows correct status.
